name: Slower reading (project preset)
description: Editable project review thresholds. These are not regulatory or distributor certification criteria.

max_cps.source: Project reading-speed limit in characters per second.

max_chars_per_line.source: Project maximum characters per caption line.

min_duration_ms.source: Project minimum caption display duration in milliseconds.

max_duration_ms.source: Project maximum caption display duration in milliseconds.

min_gap_ms.source: Project minimum gap between captions in milliseconds.

sync_tolerance_ms.source: Project tolerance for the difference between caption and detected speech start.

ad_overlap_tolerance_ms.source: Project review tolerance for audio-description overlap with dialogue.

ad_max_wpm.source: Project audio-description reading-rate limit in words per minute.

accuracy.source: Project review threshold for accuracy; not an FCC or distributor benchmark.

synchronicity.source: Project review threshold for synchronicity; not an FCC or distributor benchmark.

completeness.source: Project review threshold for completeness; not an FCC or distributor benchmark.

readability.source: Project review threshold for readability; not an FCC or distributor benchmark.

sdh.source: Project review threshold for sdh; not an FCC or distributor benchmark.

ad.source: Project review threshold for ad; not an FCC or distributor benchmark.
